name: Nawabshah

queries.query: Nawabshah Sindh Pakistan official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Board of Revenue
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh, Sindh Zameen/LARMIS public land-record portal, its deh-map service, Sindh maps page, and the Sindh e-Registration service. Search evidence describes digital land administration, cadastral survey maps, deh maps and property registers, but did not expose a public parcel feature endpoint for Nawabshah.

officialSources.observation: Official Board of Revenue Sindh portal; search evidence identifies digital land administration, property registers, survey/deh maps and revenue records.
Official Sindh maps service page identified by discovery; direct TLS-verified retrieval was not usable because the presented certificate hostname did not match.
Official Board of Revenue Sindh site; discovery evidence describes computerization of land records and GIS/geodatabase work, but this is institutional evidence rather than a parcel response.
Official Sindh e-Registration service describing deed-registration workflow; not treated as an open parcel geometry source.
